description: Save a PDF without encryption so print/copy/modify restrictions are gone. Works for owner-locked files (empty user password) with no password, and for user-password files when you pass the password. It does NOT crack unknown passwords: a wrong or missing user password fails with encrypted_pdf. A PDF that was not encrypted is returned re-saved, with note "not-encrypted". Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_unlock

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

note.description: Present as "not-encrypted" when the input had no encryption

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Remove PDF restrictions
